chartBar.doc: Compares values across categories with vertical bars. chartView with chartType 'bar'.

chartLine.doc: Shows how values change along an ordered category, such as time. chartView with chartType 'line'.

chartArea.doc: Shows how values change along an ordered category, filling the area under each line. chartView with chartType 'area'.

chartStackedBar.doc: Shows the parts of a total for each category, with the measures stacked in one bar. chartView with chartType 'stackedBar'.

chartStackedArea.doc: Shows the parts of a total along an ordered category, with the areas stacked. chartView with chartType 'stackedArea'.

chartHorizontalBar.doc: Compares values across categories with horizontal bars; suited to long category names. chartView with chartType 'horizontalBar'.

chartPie.doc: Shows the share of each category in a total. chartView with chartType 'pie'.

chartDonut.doc: Shows the share of each category in a total, as a ring. chartView with chartType 'donut'.

chartScatter.doc: Shows each row as a point, to reveal relations and clusters. chartView with chartType 'scatter'.

chartBar3D.doc: Shows a value for each pair of two dimensions as 3D columns. chartView with chartType 'bar3D'.

chartLine3D.doc: Shows values along two dimensions as lines in 3D space. chartView with chartType 'line3D'.

chartScatter3D.doc: Shows each row as a point in 3D space. chartView with chartType 'scatter3D'.

chartSurface.doc: Shows a measured surface over a grid of two numeric dimensions. chartView with chartType 'surface'.

chartMap.doc: Colours each territory of a GeoJSON map by one measure. chartView with chartType 'map'.

chartMapBar3D.doc: Raises 3D columns on the territories of a GeoJSON map. chartView with chartType 'mapBar3D'.

chartMap3D.doc: Draws the territories of a GeoJSON map in 3D, one map per measure. chartView with chartType 'map3D'.

chartLines3D.doc: Draws paths of coordinates on a 3D map. chartView with chartType 'lines3D'.

chartPolygons3D.doc: Draws polygons of coordinates as 3D shapes. chartView with chartType 'polygons3D'.

chartFunnel.doc: Shows how a quantity shrinks through ordered stages. chartView with chartType 'funnel'.

chartRadar.doc: Compares items on several measures; each measure is an axis, each row a polygon. chartView with chartType 'radar'.

chartParallel.doc: Compares rows on several measures; each measure is a vertical axis, each row a line across them. chartView with chartType 'parallel'.

chartHeatmap.doc: Colours each cell of a grid of two categories by one measure. chartView with chartType 'heatmap'.

chartSankey.doc: Shows flows between nodes; the width of each link is its value. chartView with chartType 'sankey'.

chartCandlestick.doc: Shows the open, high, low and close of each period, as used for prices. chartView with chartType 'candlestick'.

chartBoxplot.doc: Shows the spread of each group with five statistics: minimum, quartiles, median and maximum. chartView with chartType 'boxplot'.

chartTreemap.doc: Shows a hierarchy as nested rectangles whose area is the value. chartView with chartType 'treemap'.

chartSunburst.doc: Shows a hierarchy as rings; the angle of each sector is the value. chartView with chartType 'sunburst'.
